<div class="reveal card doodle">
  <h2 class="with-squiggle">Predictive Analytics – Hotel Booking Demand</h2>
  <p><span class="badge">ABT Design</span><span class="badge">Decision Trees</span><span class="badge">KNN</span><span class="badge">Regression</span></p>
  <ul>
    <li><strong>Goal:</strong> Predict cancellation risk & inform overbooking thresholds.</li>
    <li><strong>ABT:</strong> Feature engineering for lead time, seasonality, customer type, LOS; leakage checks.</li>
    <li><strong>Models:</strong> DT & KNN for classification; MLR for LOS/ADR; train/test split with cross-validation.</li>
    <li><strong>Metrics:</strong> Accuracy & F1 for cancellations; MAE/RMSE for regression.</li>
    <li><strong>Outcome:</strong> Thresholds for high-risk bookings; recommendation memo + comparison table.</li>
  </ul>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const els = [...document.querySelectorAll('.reveal')];
  const io = new IntersectionObserver(e => e.forEach(x => {
    if (x.isIntersecting) x.target.classList.add('is-visible');
  }), {threshold:.15});
  els.forEach(el => io.observe(el));
});
</script>
